# Results matrix (generated by tools/summarize.mjs, 2026-08-17T19:11:27.232Z)

Environment: node v26.3.1, darwin arm64, , .
Every cell below was produced by a run in this repo (results/*.json); nothing from literature.

EmbedRGA and SidedEmbedRGA are both first-class verified designs. EmbedRGA targets lower retained metadata; SidedEmbedRGA retains additional ordering-policy state to prevent the documented interleaving anomaly. The tables present both so applications can choose that space/semantics tradeoff. RGA is the verified explicit-tombstone baseline.
